preconditions.evidence: SuperNeoHashOracles.swift implements Merkle-style CTCOMoveOneCommitment roots with local opening verification, and ProofEnvelopeCTCOVerifier recomputes Root_k and the proof-envelope challenge seed for fold, terminal, compressed-terminal, NumiSeal-terminal, and NumiSealZK product proof envelopes

ProofEnvelopeCTCOVerifier derives one 256-bit proof-envelope challenge seed per accepted proof kind; SuperNeoChallengeTape expands H_chal seeds into labelled digest, field, extension-field, and ring challenges; SumCheckTranscript and the fold, terminal CE, NumiSeal aggregation, scalarization, residual sum-check, and NumiSealZK masked-residual accumulation paths consume that tape instead of the legacy SHA256-counter micro-challenge schedule

SuperNeoHashOracles.swift provides SHAKE256, Digest384, H_bind, H_chal, H_mt, CTCO context/root helpers, and replay/carry H_bind projections; SuperNeoSerialization.swift, NumiSealProof.swift, NumiSealArtifactVerifier.swift, NumiSealProductProver.swift, LocalProductControls.swift, and product CLI paths now route theorem-critical context, artifact/root, transcript, and replay acceptance comparisons through 384-bit H_bind binders
TestVectors/product-qrom-sampler-encoding-evidence-v1.json pins rejection-sampling arithmetic under the QRO abstraction; CTCO keeps a 256-bit seed and deterministic counter expansion
TestVectors/product-qrom-sampler-encoding-evidence-v1.json links the Swift 64-bit length-frame implementation to Lean transcript frame injectivity for structured frames

ProductInteractiveDelayedMessageData pins artifact, provenance, replay, component-root, randomness-session, leakage, and carry binders as first-message H_bind targets; later witness-dependent openings are accepted only after verifier recomputation of the corresponding binders and Root_k

ProductInteractiveUniqueResponseData pins per-kind deterministic response rules: fold, terminal, compressed-terminal after canonical decompression, NumiSeal terminal, and NumiSealZK product responses are unique relative to Root_k, rho_k, framed context binders, and verified local openings, with ambiguity charged to Root_k/H_bind/canonical-decompression bad events
knowledge soundness or soundness bound for the exact CTCO product protocol against quantum dishonest provers
NumiSealZK requires simulator composition for the masked residual relation after CTCO root binding
TestVectors/product-qrom-transcript-schedule-v1.json pins Q_H = 2^64; CTCO uses this as the adversary oracle-query cap, not as a micro-round count

ProductQROMCompilerOverheadBound pins epsilon_compiler_overhead = 0 in the ideal split-QRO CTCO model: online extractability is assumed by the theorem, legacy micro-round/factorial loss is excluded, H_bind target failures are exported to epsilon_collision, and remaining interactive/extractor/simulator losses are charged outside epsilon_qrom

TestVectors/product-qrom-collision-malleability-evidence-v1.json pins nine structural binding-target events and the 4 * 9 * Q_H^2 / 2^384 bound; source H_bind acceptance binding is implemented and tracked by the hbind-384-acceptance-bindings precondition
